text:
maria: Starting canary rollout of CUDA/driver bundle 536 on k8s-gpu pool (eu-west-1). Staging looked fine. Enabling healthlet circuit-breaker (observe->auto-failover) for the canary. Sharing grafana and logs links: <https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/driver-health?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west-1>
kevin: Copy. What's the circuit-breaker threshold for Xid/NCCL errors for canaries?
sophie: For canary we set tight values after last month: 3 Xid errors or 2 NCCL watchdogs within 5m triggers failover. Production default is laxer (5/10m).
kevin: Good catch. Also FYI we saw link training flakiness on some older Ampere boards with 536 in perf lab (PCIe retrains + transient ECC). Keep an eye on link_errors metric.
ryan_oncall: I'm already seeing a small spike on host gpu-az3-12: Xid 62 repeated, then one `NCCL WATCHDOG` at 02:14:28 UTC. Pods started rescheduling. Pasting tail of dmesg for that host:
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: Xid (0001:0062) at 0x00000000
[  123.457000] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  123.457210] kernel: nv_peer_mem: probe of 0000:3b:00.0 failed with error -16
[  123.457400] nvidia-modeset: Unregistered GPU 0
[  123.457600] watchdog: BUG: soft lockup in process <...>
```
maria: Thanks. If that pattern hits 3 distinct nodes in 10m we'll rollback the driver across eu-west-1. For now, isolate gpu-az3-12 and run `kubectl cordon --reason=driver-canary gpu-az3-12` and attach debug job.
ryan_oncall: Doing cordon + debug. Also raised a paged alert to the infra rotation. @alertbot can you escalate to oncall group if Xid_count(eu-west-1)>3 in 10m?
alertbot: Alert rule updated: `driver.canary.xid_count > 3 in 10m` -> notify oncall, post to #eng-sre, annotate grafana. (rule id: canary-536-xid)
